cohort: The study included 518 normal pregnancies with no history of preterm birth, comprising 272 term deliveries and 246 spontaneous preterm births.
finding: Fetuses with subsequent late, early, and very early preterm birth showed significantly higher values of nuchal translucency and fetal heart rate at the first-trimester scan, with higher values correlating with more severe PTB.
gest_age: Gestational age at delivery for preterm births was categorized as prior to 37, 34, 32, and 28 weeks; exposure measurements were taken at the first-trimester scan.
